games.title: Hollow Knight
games.description: Descend into Hallownest, a vast kingdom of forgotten insects and ancient secrets. Precision combat and winding caverns make every discovery feel earned.

games.title: Ori and the Blind Forest
games.description: Guide Ori through a beautifully hand-painted forest threatened by a spreading blight. Fluid platforming and an emotional story make this a memorable journey.

games.title: Ori and the Will of the Wisps
games.description: Explore a vast, strange world as Ori searches for a lost friend. New abilities, expressive characters, and demanding platforming deepen the adventure.

games.title: Celeste
games.description: Help Madeline climb Celeste Mountain through precise, screen-sized platforming challenges. Its intimate story explores anxiety, perseverance, and self-acceptance.

games.title: Sea of Stars
games.description: Join two Children of the Solstice on a vibrant quest to stop an ancient alchemist. This turn-based role-playing adventure pairs timing-based combat with handcrafted exploration.

games.title: Undertale
games.description: Descend into a monster-filled underground world and decide how you will treat its inhabitants. Your choices shape encounters, relationships, and the story's outcome.

games.title: Cuphead
games.description: Take on a series of demanding boss battles in a world inspired by 1930s cartoons. Its hand-drawn animation and energetic soundtrack frame a tough but fair challenge.

games.title: Journey
games.description: Travel across a vast desert toward a distant mountain in a wordless, atmospheric adventure. You may encounter another traveler online, sharing the journey without spoken communication.

games.title: Stray
games.description: Explore a decaying cybercity as a stray cat separated from its family. Solve environmental puzzles, meet its robot residents, and find a way back outside.

games.title: Limbo
games.description: A boy searches a monochrome, perilous world for his sister. Environmental puzzles and minimalist sound design build an unsettling atmosphere.

games.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
games.description: Play as monster hunter Geralt in a sprawling fantasy world shaped by political conflict and personal choices. Contracts, exploration, and character-driven quests fill the journey.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim
games.description: Explore the province of Skyrim as a Dragonborn in this open-ended fantasy role-playing game. Follow the main quest or build your own adventures across its mountains and towns.

games.title: Elden Ring
games.description: Journey through the Lands Between, an expansive fantasy realm filled with hidden dungeons and formidable foes. Discover its history at your own pace in this challenging action role-playing adventure.

games.title: Baldur's Gate 3
games.description: Gather a party and shape a Dungeons & Dragons story through tactical battles and meaningful choices. Your decisions can change relationships, quests, and the fate of the Sword Coast.

games.title: Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade
games.description: Return to Midgar in a reimagining of the opening chapter of Final Fantasy VII. Switch between party members and combine real-time action with tactical commands.

games.title: Persona 5 Royal
games.description: Live a double life as a Tokyo student and a Phantom Thief in this stylish role-playing game. Build friendships by day and explore supernatural palaces in turn-based battles.

games.title: Dragon Age: Inquisition
games.description: Lead the Inquisition across a world torn by magical upheaval and political danger. Recruit companions, make consequential choices, and shape the future of Thedas.

games.title: Stardew Valley
games.description: Leave the city behind, restore your grandfather's farm, and get to know the people of Pelican Town. Grow crops, raise animals, fish, and make the countryside your own.

games.title: The Sims 4
games.description: Create Sims, design homes, and guide everyday lives in a flexible life simulation. The base game is free to play, with optional expansion content available separately.

games.title: Minecraft
games.description: Shape a block-built world by gathering resources, crafting tools, and constructing whatever you imagine. Play creatively or try to survive nights filled with hostile creatures.

games.title: Terraria
games.description: Dig, fight, explore, and build in a lively two-dimensional world. Discover materials, craft gear, and prepare for increasingly ambitious bosses and biomes.

games.title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
games.description: Build a personal island getaway, decorate your home, and meet a cast of animal neighbors. The island changes with the seasons and invites relaxed, day-by-day play.

games.title: Cities: Skylines
games.description: Plan roads, neighborhoods, and services as your small settlement grows into a city. Balance budgets and infrastructure while responding to the needs of its residents.

games.title: Planet Zoo
games.description: Build a wildlife park, care for animals, and design habitats that meet their needs. Detailed construction tools let you create a zoo from the ground up.

games.title: Cyberpunk 2077
games.description: Become V, a mercenary navigating the neon-lit streets of Night City. Shape your build and relationships as an ambitious heist pulls you into a conflict over identity and power.

games.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.description: Follow outlaw Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang across a richly detailed American frontier. Explore, hunt, and make choices as the gang struggles to survive a changing world.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto V
games.description: Switch between three distinct protagonists in the sprawling city of Los Santos and Blaine County. Its story mode blends heists, driving, and open-ended exploration.

games.title: Ghost of Tsushima Director's Cut
games.description: Fight to protect Tsushima Island as samurai Jin Sakai during the Mongol invasion. Explore a cinematic landscape and choose how to balance honorable combat with stealth.

games.title: Marvel's Spider-Man Remastered
games.description: Swing through a detailed Manhattan as Peter Parker faces a threat to the city. Fast-paced combat, acrobatic traversal, and a character-focused story bring this superhero adventure to life.

games.title: God of War
games.description: Join Kratos and Atreus on a dangerous journey through the realms of Norse mythology. Their relationship develops alongside weighty combat and exploration.

games.title: Assassin's Creed Odyssey
games.description: Travel across ancient Greece as a mercenary caught in a war between Athens and Sparta. Explore islands, make story choices, and uncover a personal family history.

games.title: Horizon Zero Dawn Complete Edition
games.description: Join hunter Aloy as she investigates a wild world dominated by machine creatures. Track machines, uncover the past, and explore a distinctive post-apocalyptic landscape.

games.title: Resident Evil 2
games.description: Survive a nightmare in Raccoon City as Leon and Claire uncover the truth behind a devastating outbreak. Resource management and tense exploration keep danger close.

games.title: Resident Evil 4
games.description: Play as agent Leon S. Kennedy on a mission to rescue the president's daughter in a remote European village. A tense mix of resourceful combat, exploration, and survival drives the journey.

games.title: Silent Hill 2
games.description: Follow James Sunderland into the fog-shrouded town of Silent Hill after receiving a letter from his late wife. Psychological dread and unsettling encounters build a deeply personal mystery.

games.title: Outlast
games.description: Investigate the abandoned Mount Massive Asylum as journalist Miles Upshur. With no way to fight back, you must hide, observe, and find a route through the darkness.

games.title: Outlast 2
games.description: Search for answers in a remote settlement after a helicopter crash leaves journalist Blake Langermann stranded. Stealth and a night-vision camera are vital in a hostile landscape.

games.title: Amnesia: The Dark Descent
games.description: Wake in a desolate castle with no memory and a note instructing you to descend into its depths. Avoid what lurks there while managing your character's dwindling sense of safety.

games.title: Little Nightmares
games.description: Guide Six through the Maw, a vast vessel inhabited by grotesque residents. Sneak, climb, and solve environmental puzzles in a haunting miniature world.

games.title: Little Nightmares II
games.description: Help Mono and Six cross a distorted world shaped by a mysterious transmission. Stealth, platforming, and environmental puzzles lead through its unsettling locations.

games.title: Phasmophobia
games.description: Team up to investigate haunted locations and identify the ghost using evidence-gathering equipment. The investigation grows more dangerous as the haunting intensifies.

games.title: Dead Space
games.description: Explore the derelict USG Ishimura as engineer Isaac Clarke searches for his crew. Strategic dismemberment and scarce supplies turn every encounter into a fight to survive.

games.title: The Forest
games.description: Stranded in a forest after a plane crash, search for your missing son and gather what you need to survive. Build shelter and explore a dangerous peninsula populated by hostile mutants.

games.title: Sons of the Forest
games.description: Search a remote island for a missing billionaire while crafting tools and building a place to defend. Explore alone or with friends as the island's threats evolve.

games.title: Subnautica
games.description: Crash-land on an alien ocean world and dive through its vivid, dangerous ecosystems. Gather resources, build underwater tools, and uncover what happened to your ship.

games.title: The Last of Us Part I
games.description: Travel across a post-pandemic United States with Joel and Ellie in a story-driven survival adventure. Scavenge carefully and navigate encounters shaped by infected and human threats.

games.title: Portal 2
games.description: Solve inventive physics puzzles using a portal device in a series of test chambers. Sharp writing and cooperative challenges expand the original game's ideas.

games.title: The Witness
games.description: Wake on a mysterious island covered in interconnected line puzzles. Explore its landscapes and learn the rules by observation, without hand-holding or a traditional quest log.

games.title: Sid Meier's Civilization VI
games.description: Build a civilization from its first settlement through the space age in this turn-based strategy game. Expand, research, negotiate, and compete for victory across a changing map.

games.title: Age of Empires IV
games.description: Lead a historical civilization through campaigns and real-time battles across the medieval era. Gather resources, develop your settlement, and adapt your army to the battlefield.

games.title: Hades
games.description: Battle out of the Underworld as Zagreus, combining weapons and boons from the gods of Olympus. Each escape attempt builds on an evolving story and changing combat challenges.

games.title: Slay the Spire
games.description: Build a deck as you climb a constantly changing tower filled with enemies and branching paths. Thoughtful card choices and relic combinations make every run different.

games.title: Forza Horizon 5
games.description: Race across a large, varied interpretation of Mexico in a festival built around cars and exploration. Discover events, collect vehicles, and tune your ride for different terrain.

games.title: Need for Speed Heat
games.description: Race through Palm City by day and risk illegal street events by night. Earn money in sanctioned races while outrunning the police after dark.

games.title: Assetto Corsa
games.description: Drive a selection of licensed cars on laser-scanned circuits in a focused racing simulation. Tune assists and setups to suit your experience and racing style.

games.title: Control
games.description: Enter the shifting Oldest House as Jesse Faden searches for answers about her past. Master supernatural abilities and explore a mysterious federal bureau under siege.

games.title: Alan Wake
games.description: Search for your missing wife in the town of Bright Falls as thriller writer Alan Wake. A mysterious story unfolds through exploration and combat against shadowy enemies.

games.title: Dead by Daylight
games.description: Take part in asymmetric multiplayer matches as either a lone killer or one of four survivors. Teamwork, stealth, and quick decisions determine who escapes the trial.

games.title: Outer Wilds
games.description: Explore a handcrafted solar system caught in a time loop and piece together the fate of an ancient civilization. Curiosity and observation, rather than upgrades, uncover its mysteries.

games.title: Risk of Rain 2
games.description: Fight across an alien planet where each passing moment makes the hostile world more dangerous. Collect unpredictable items and build a run alone or with friends.
